result.summary: Adds an opt-in `verify_balance` argument to `importdescriptors` that, when enabled, scans the chainstate UTXO set for the wallet's known scripts, compares it against the wallet's own view, and extends the rescan backward if outputs are missing. It introduces a new `interfaces::Chain::findCoinsByScript` method, a `ScanWalletUTXOSet` wallet helper, and returns a detailed info object describing the verification outcome. A large functional test suite covers recovery, mismatches, mempool transactions, and pruned-block failure cases.
result.problem: Users who import descriptors with a timestamp that is too recent can silently end up with an incomplete wallet balance because the rescan starts too late to find older payments; issue #28898 asks for a way to double-check the calculated balance against the chain.

result.card: This PR adds an opt-in verify_balance option to importdescriptors that scans the chainstate UTXO set for the wallet's known scripts, compares it to the wallet's own UTXO view, and extends the rescan backward when it finds a discrepancy, aiming to fix long-standing issue #28898 about incomplete balances after importing descriptors with a too-recent timestamp. It is a wallet-first change (with a mechanical new interfaces::Chain method to support the scan) that adds real user value for wallet-recovery scenarios, though it is opt-in and not a fund-safety fix by default. Four other open PRs (#35989, #35377, #34861, #31668) attack overlapping parts of the same problem, indicating the project wants a fix but has not converged on an approach. The PR itself has zero reviewer engagement (Crickets) and is flagged Needs rebase with a dirty mergeable state, so it is not currently reviewable without a rebase, and reviewers may prefer to look at the competing PRs first.
